title: Pharaoh's Riches
features: 20 fixed win lines. Wins pay left to right on adjacent reels.
SUN OF RA is WILD — it substitutes for every symbol except the Pyramid.
PYRAMID is a scatter — 3 or more anywhere pay a multiple of the total bet and award 12 FREE SPINS.
After any win, try the GAMBLE: guess the card colour to double your win (up to 5 times).
